## Envoy Mirror v2
Copies tablet (Envoy) bookings from each room's resource calendar onto KDC Bookings, where Jessie's guards already look. PENDING 42; design: docs/design/envoy-mirror-build.md.

- A copy: `<Room> - <tablet title>`, location `<Room>`, private `envoyMirrorSource`. No `ref:`, so Jessie refuses to cancel/move it. Never invites the room.
- Fails closed: a room whose read failed gets no deletes; a failed or partial KDC read writes nothing; more than 25 deletes in one run are held.
- Fails loudly: a failed write, or no room calendar readable at all, turns the run red.
- Successful runs are **not saved** (Settings), or 720 runs a day would fill the database the way it did on 2-3 Sep. Failed runs and manual test runs are saved.
- Run record: the first item out of **Plan Changes** (`op: summary`).
